name: norbornane
source_note: bicyclic; polycyclic strain values are approximate here

name: bicyclobutane
source_note: fused bicyclopropane system; very highly strained

name: bicyclo[2.2.2]octane
source_note: Benson group-additivity strain vs NIST dfH-gas=-23.67 kcal/mol (Wong & Westrum 1971); method cross-checked against norbornane's literature 17.2 kcal/mol and reproduces it within ~1 kcal/mol

name: cubane
source_note: widely-cited figure (Eaton synthesis papers onward); benzene bioisostere core e.g. in cubane-based BACE1 inhibitors

name: cycloheptadecane
source_note: Yale thermochem compilation; macrocycle slightly MORE stable than acyclic reference

name: cyclopentyne
source_note: G3-level ab initio (Bach 2009 JACS 131 5233); sp-center forced into 5-ring

name: cyclooctyne
source_note: G3-level ab initio (Bach 2009 JACS 131 5233); the classic SPAAC/click-chemistry alkyne

name: morpholine
source_note: 6-membered O+N heterocycle; chair conformation is essentially strain-free like cyclohexane

name: piperazine
source_note: 6-membered di-N heterocycle; chair conformation essentially strain-free

name: 1-4-dioxane
source_note: 6-membered di-O heterocycle; chair conformation essentially strain-free

name: 1-3-dioxolane
source_note: 5-membered di-O heterocycle; estimated by analogy to THF

name: oxazolidine
source_note: 5-membered O+N heterocycle; estimated by analogy to THF/pyrrolidine

name: imidazolidine
source_note: 5-membered di-N heterocycle; estimated by analogy to pyrrolidine

name: thiazolidine
source_note: 5-membered S+N heterocycle; estimated by analogy to tetrahydrothiophene

name: azepane
source_note: 7-membered N heterocycle; estimated by analogy to cycloheptane

name: oxepane
source_note: 7-membered O heterocycle; estimated by analogy to cycloheptane

name: thiepane
source_note: 7-membered S heterocycle; estimated by analogy to cycloheptane

name: silacyclobutane
source_note: 4-membered Si heterocycle; group-13-16 4-ring RSE compilation (Inorg. Chem. 2025)

name: phosphetane
source_note: 4-membered P heterocycle; group-13-16 4-ring RSE compilation (Inorg. Chem. 2025)
